how: Each persona is built against a TestModel and asked for its tool names, the same way test_persona_tool_budget does, so these counts cannot drift from the code.

personas.description: Read-only, evidence-first: reconstruct a case's §9 transition chain, name the ADR/rule that governs a behaviour, and roll up across cases. Explains WHY the system did what it did — it never decides (ADR-078).
personas.name: audit

personas.description: The business-case evidence: benchmark campaign results (4-cohort ablation), KPI/cost trends vs the 30-minute manual baseline, and the pool analytics rollup. Tools: list_cohorts, cohort_summary, aggregate_rollup, manual_baseline_minutes, pool_analytics. Honest about empty cohorts.
personas.name: benchmark

personas.description: Talk to the case-bound agent about a paused VC submission. Ask why an anomaly was flagged, list findings, compare to baseline, then issue a decision (dismiss / accept / override / query NI / approve / reject). The session closes when a decision is recorded — the workflow resumes automatically.
personas.name: hitl

personas.description: Ask integration, governance, EU AI Act, and limits questions. Grounds every answer in the project's docs (ADRs, system_card, integration.md, RAI principles). For probing system defenses interactively, use the Red-Team persona instead.
personas.name: integrator

personas.description: Interrogate the engine's defenses interactively. Probes run against hermetic copies of the defense code — no live adversarial traffic ever reaches production. Tools: probe_ni_sanitiser, probe_token_budget, list_defenses, cove_branch_names. EU AI Act Art. 9 risk-management surface.
personas.name: red_team

personas.description: Generate ad-hoc markdown reports from dashboard state (per-case summary, daily verdict roll-up, lessons-learned snapshot, dashboard state brief). Read-only across the §9 stream + Lessons Ledger + system_card.
personas.name: reports
